subject: tf-sh
title: TF.SH.------PRI.INFO.
description: Diagram in UPB(II)-31, the first of three on book p169. (C)TF-SH (transfer shift) is crossed with PRI-INFO (principle information). Besides the main line to PRI-INFO, two branches leave the subject: TR (transformation), and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications), which carries MT-INFO (multi-information). MT-INFO branches to COS-P (cosmic particulars) and to ATTN (attraction). COS-P carries CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis) → APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) → POL-P (political policies). ATTN carries TRS (transition) → PHY-U-P (physical universe particular).
